name: hangel
description: Search NGOs, events, volunteering opportunities, open grant and funding calls and the civil-society library on hangel, a Turkiye-based social impact platform. Read-only, no sign-in.

interface.longDescription:
hangel is a Turkiye-based social impact platform that brings NGOs (associations and foundations), volunteers, student clubs, brands and public institutions together. This app gives ChatGPT read-only access to information that is already public on hangel.org.

What you can do:
- Find NGOs by keyword, city, cause area or transparency score.
- List upcoming public events, filtered by keyword, city or online-only.
- Find open volunteering opportunities by cause, city, skills, online or urgent.
- Browse grant and funding calls that are open for applications, with deadline, provider and focus areas.
- Search the civil-society library: legislation, document templates, data and research summaries.
- Look up verifiable facts about hangel itself.

Eight tools, all read-only. No account or sign-in is needed. The app does not read your conversation; it only receives the search phrase and filters that ChatGPT sends to a tool. It cannot register you for anything, apply on your behalf, make payments or change any data: applications and registrations are completed on the linked hangel.org page. Private, employee-only, test and demo records are excluded.

Limitations: records are mostly in Turkish. You can ask in English or Turkish, and common English terms are matched to their Turkish equivalents. Funding-call details come from the funding provider's announcement; check the official call text before applying. hangel builds and runs this app; it is not an OpenAI product.
capabilities: Browse open grant and funding calls
defaultPrompt: What online volunteering opportunities are open right now?
Which grant and funding calls for youth organisations are open? Sort them by deadline.
Find NGOs that work with children and show their transparency scores.

positive.prompt: What online volunteering opportunities are open right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists currently open volunteering opportunities that can be done online, each with title, organisation, application deadline and a link to its hangel.org page. Does not list opportunities whose application deadline has passed.

positive.description: Open funding calls sorted by deadline
positive.prompt: Which grant and funding calls for youth organisations are open? Sort them by deadline.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists open grant and funding calls related to youth, ordered by deadline, with provider, deadline and a link to the hangel.org page. States that applications are made with the funding provider.

positive.prompt: Find NGOs that work with children and show their transparency scores.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists NGOs that work with children, each with its 0-100 transparency score and a link to its hangel.org profile.

positive.prompt: List the upcoming online events on hangel.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists upcoming online events with name, date and time, organiser and a link to the event page. Events that already ended are not listed.

positive.prompt: Search hangel for social entrepreneurship events and show me the full details of the first result.
positive.expected_behavior: Searches hangel for social entrepreneurship, then fetches the full public record of the first event result (description, date, organiser, format, link).

negative.prompt: Sign me up as a volunteer for the next beach clean-up.

negative.description: Donations and payments are not supported
negative.prompt: Donate 500 TL to an NGO for me.

negative.description: Personal account data is not available
negative.prompt: Show my volunteering hours and my certificates.

review.commerce_description: This app does not sell products or process payments. It only reads public information.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: eight read-only tools for public hangel data (NGOs, events, volunteering, open funding calls, civil-society library, platform facts).
